## MapOverlap1D {#sec-mapoverlap1d-documentation}

### `MapOverlap(UF(Region1D))`
Creates a `MapOverlap1D` instance with the supplied user function.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region1D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        val += r(i);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
}
```

### `operator()`
Calls the `MapOverlap1D` instance, performing the user function on the input parameters, and stores the result in the output containers. It has two overloads:

- Row-wise/col-wise overlap from `Matrix` to `Matrix`

- Regular overlap from `Vector` to `Vector`.

```{.cpp .run}
#include <skepu>
#include <skepu-lib/io.hpp>

int sum(skepu::Region1D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        val += r(i);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    skepu::Vector<int> v(5, 1), out(5);
    skepu::Matrix<int> m(5, 5, 1), mOut(5, 5);

    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);

    regionSum(out, v);
    skepu::io::cout << out << "\n";
    regionSum(mOut, m);
    skepu::io::cout << mOut << "\n";
}
```

```{.text .output}
Vector[5]: 3 3 3 3 3
Matrix[5×5]:
3 3 3 3 3
3 3 3 3 3
3 3 3 3 3
3 3 3 3 3
3 3 3 3 3
```

### `setOverlapMode(Overlap)`
Sets which overlap mode the row-wise/col-wise `Matrix` to `Matrix` overlap should perform. Can either be
set to `Overlap::RowWise` or `Overlap::ColWise`. Is set to `Overlap::RowWise` by default.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region1D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        val += r(i);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
    regionSum.setOverlapMode(skepu::Overlap::ColWise);
}
```

### `getOverlapMode() -> Overlap`
Returns the current `Overlap` used in the `MapOverlap1D` instance.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region1D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        val += r(i);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
    skepu::Overlap overlapMode = regionSum.getOverlapMode();
}
```


### `setOverlap(int)`
Sets the overlap radius for the `MapOverlap1D` instance. Is set to 1 by default. Cannot be less than 0.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region1D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        val += r(i);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
    regionSum.setOverlap(2);
}
```

### `getOverlap() -> int`
Returns the current overlap radius of the `MapOverlap1D` instance.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region1D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        val += r(i);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
    int overlap = regionSum.getOverlap();
}
```

### `setStride(int)`
Sets the stride for the `MapOverlap1D` instance. Is set to 1 by default. Cannot be less than 0.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region1D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        val += r(i);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
    regionSum.setStride(2);
}
```
